market_view: Calm regime: VIX 15.45, down 15% in 20 days. Long yields high (30-year at 5.23% per a Motley Fool piece), dollar soft; GDP, PCE and NVDA earnings all land today.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI fell 3.1% on 08-25; a driver move already happened and is priced in. No XOM, OPEC+ or supply headline. The oil_gas headlines are unrelated noise (fleet awards, class actions).

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM is at its 252-day high, +47.7% in 20 days, with gold +16%. That is priced in and no Fed, dollar or NEM headline explains it. Chasing it is momentum, which is not a catalyst.

chips.catalyst: none: NVDA earnings after the close today (Motley Fool, 'Nvidia Earnings, Inflation, and GDP on the Same Day') is scheduled but has no one-sided setup
chips.reasoning: Earnings add variance, not direction. No pre-announcement, guidance or export-rule headline. The AMD and SOXX pieces are opinion.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline. The AbbVie stake piece and the market reports are noise. LLY is 3.6% below its high with weak sector link.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX is at its high, +20.5% in 5 days, with copper at a high too. That move is priced in and there is no copper supply, China data or FCX headline. A momentum chase is not a catalyst.

would_change_my_mind: A named headline on a leader: guidance change, export-rule change, regulator decision, supply shock or OPEC+ action.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the last note (08-21). WTI fell 3.1% to 82.36 on 08-25 and NEM rose to a new high (+47.7% in 20 days). FCX is +20.5% in 5 days at a high and MRK is +15.7% in 5 days. Headlines on 08-26 were again noise; the NVDA earnings (after close today) are confirmed.

copper_uranium.why: FCX at highs after +20.5% in 5 days has no copper supply, China data or FCX headline behind it.
